printStation.title: Print Station
printStation.subtitle: keep this page open on the counter PC
printStation.autoPrintOff: KOT auto-print is off, so only KOTs staff reprint will arrive here.

setup.title: Set up silent printing (once per PC)
setup.step1: Set the kitchen/thermal printer as the PC's default printer.
setup.step2: Close Chrome, then start it with --kiosk-printing. Windows: right-click the Chrome shortcut → Properties → add --kiosk-printing after chrome.exe".
setup.step3: Open this page, press Test print. It should print without a dialog.
setup.step4: Leave the page open. It keeps the screen awake and prints each KOT as it arrives.

printStation.nothingPrinted: Nothing printed yet. New KOTs print here automatically.
